noun.gloss: the requirements of an application

noun.gloss: a collection or group of related applications, often deployed together

noun.gloss: configuration values that control the behavior of an application

noun.gloss: the original code of an application

noun.gloss: a set of software subsystems or components needed to run an application

noun.gloss: The current condition and data of a running application that can be stored and restored.

noun.example: The company uses application stream technology to deliver software to remote employees.

noun.gloss: a way of evaluating or testing

noun.example_zh: 审计管理平台收集并整理来自各种来源的证据。

an application that processes or uses big data
noun.example: We built a big data application to analyze logs.
noun.example_zh: 我们构建了一个大数据应用来分析日志。

noun.gloss: a time frame for billing purposes
noun.example: The bill period starts on the first of each month.
noun.example_zh: 账单周期从每月第一天开始。

noun.gloss: a report detailing charges or billing information
noun.example: I need to check my phone bill report.
noun.example_zh: 我需要查看手机账单报告。

noun.example: Download the monthly bill report for our cloud account.
noun.example_zh: 下载我们云账户的月度账单报告。
noun.gloss: a report summarizing cloud usage costs
a type of machine learning task with two possible outcomes
noun.example: Binary classification predicts spam or not spam.
noun.example_zh: 二元分类预测垃圾邮件或非垃圾邮件。

noun.example: The file contains binary data that must be parsed.
noun.example_zh: 文件包含需要解析的二进制数据。
noun.gloss: information encoded in binary form
a file containing data in binary format, not human‑readable text
noun.example: Binary files cannot be read with a text editor.
noun.example_zh: 二进制文件无法用文本编辑器阅读。

noun.gloss: a representation of data using binary code
noun.example: The data is transmitted in binary format.
noun.example_zh: 数据以二进制格式传输。

noun.gloss: a log file containing database changes in binary format, used for replication and recovery
noun.example: Enable binary logging for replication.
noun.example_zh: 启用二进制日志以进行复制。

noun.example: Push your code changes to the Bitbucket repository.
noun.example_zh: 将你的代码更改推送到 Bitbucket 仓库。
noun.gloss: a version-controlled project container hosted on Bitbucket

noun.example: Attach a block device to your instance.
noun.example_zh: 将块设备附加到实例。
noun.gloss: a storage device that supports random access

noun.example: The system supports both block object and traditional file protocols.
noun.example_zh: 该系统支持块对象和传统文件协议。
noun.gloss: An object that stores block-level data, typically used in distributed storage systems to implement block devices.
security setting preventing public internet access
noun.example: Turn on block public access for your bucket.
noun.example_zh: 为存储桶开启阻止公共访问。

noun.example: The firewall maintains a log of every block request for security analysis.
noun.example_zh: 防火墙会记录每个阻止请求用于安全分析。
noun.gloss: the action of denying a request or a request that is denied
the size of a data block in storage or transmission
noun.example: A larger block size can improve throughput.
noun.example_zh: 更大的块大小可以提高吞吐量。

verb.example: You can configure network ACLs to block SMB.
verb.example_zh: 您可以配置网络 ACL 来阻止 SMB。
verb.gloss: to deny SMB (Server Message Block) protocol traffic

noun.example: Block storage is commonly used in cloud environments for attaching volumes to virtual machines.
noun.example_zh: 块存储通常用于云环境中，为虚拟机附加卷。
noun.gloss: A type of data storage that stores data in fixed-sized blocks
a storage volume providing block-level access
noun.example: Attach the block store to an instance.
noun.example_zh: 将块存储附加到实例。

noun.gloss: a decentralized network that records transactions on a blockchain
noun.example: Join the blockchain network as a node.
noun.example_zh: 作为节点加入区块链网络。

noun.gloss: a digital asset or entity on a blockchain network
noun.example: The smart contract is a blockchain resource.
noun.example_zh: 智能合约是一种区块链资源。

noun.gloss: an article published on a blog
noun.example: She published a blog post about the conference.
noun.example_zh: 她发表了一篇关于会议的博客文章。

noun.example: We used a blue/green deployment to switch traffic to the new version.
noun.example_zh: 我们使用蓝绿部署将流量切换到新版本。
noun.gloss: a deployment method using two identical environments to reduce downtime and risk
a variable that can hold true or false to indicate a state
noun.example: Use a boolean flag to track whether the operation succeeded.
noun.example_zh: 使用布尔标志来跟踪操作是否成功。

noun.gloss: a value of true or false
noun.example: The condition returns a boolean value.
noun.example_zh: 条件返回一个布尔值。

noun.gloss: the mode in which a computer boots, e.g., UEFI or Legacy BIOS
noun.example: Select the boot mode in the firmware settings.
noun.example_zh: 在固件设置中选择启动模式。

noun.gloss: a script that initializes or configures a system at startup
noun.example: The bootstrap script installs necessary packages on new instances.
noun.example_zh: 引导脚本在新实例上安装必要的软件包。

noun.gloss: a router that connects one network to another, often used in the context of the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP)
noun.example: The border gateway is responsible for routing traffic between the internal network and the internet.
noun.example_zh: 边界网关负责在内部网络和互联网之间路由流量。

noun.gloss: management of automated programs or robots
noun.example: The factory uses bot control for assembly line robots.
noun.example_zh: 工厂使用机器人控制来管理装配线机器人。

noun.example: Configure bot control to block malicious bots.
noun.example_zh: 配置机器人流量管理以阻止恶意机器人。
noun.gloss: Feature to manage and mitigate traffic from automated bots in cloud platforms and web applications.
category of robot or automated program
noun.example: What bot type is this chatbot?
noun.example_zh: 这个聊天机器人是什么类型的？

noun.example: Select the bot type from the configuration menu.
noun.example_zh: 从配置菜单中选择机器人类型。
noun.gloss: category of a bot in a computer system or platform
a rectangular border around an object in an image
noun.example: Use bounding boxes to identify objects in the image.
noun.example_zh: 使用边界框来识别图像中的对象。

noun.example: What is the branch name of this bank?
noun.example_zh: 这家银行的分支名称是什么？
noun.gloss: the name of a branch, e.g., of a tree, a bank, or a company division
noun.meaning: 分支名称（树木、组织等的）

noun.gloss: the name of a branch in a version control system
noun.example: Enter a branch name for the new feature.
noun.example_zh: 输入新功能的分支名称。

noun.gloss: a short explanation
noun.example: Please provide a brief description of the problem.
noun.example_zh: 请提供问题的简要描述。

noun.gloss: a short length of time
noun.example: Wait for a brief period before proceeding.
noun.example_zh: 请稍等片刻再继续。

noun.gloss: a short duration, e.g., for timeouts
noun.example: The service may experience a brief period of unavailability.
noun.example_zh: 服务可能会经历短暂的不可用时间。

noun.example: Avoid granting broad permission to users.
noun.example_zh: 避免授予用户宽泛权限。
noun.gloss: permission that is not narrowly scoped
a wide range or collection
noun.example: The course covers a broad set of topics.
noun.example_zh: 该课程涵盖广泛的主题。

noun.gloss: a program or code that runs within a web browser
noun.example: Some websites require a browser script to function.
noun.example_zh: 某些网站需要浏览器脚本才能运行。

noun.gloss: client-side code, typically JavaScript, executed by a web browser
noun.example: The browser script manipulates the DOM.
noun.example_zh: 浏览器脚本操作DOM。

noun.example: I have many browser tabs open for my research.
noun.example_zh: 我打开了很多浏览器标签页用于研究。
noun.gloss: a separate page or view within a web browser that can be opened and switched between
the window of a web browser on a computer screen
noun.example: I have too many browser windows open.
noun.example_zh: 我打开了太多浏览器窗口。

noun.gloss: a web browser window used to access web applications
noun.example: Log in to the console in a new browser window.
noun.example_zh: 在新的浏览器窗口中登录控制台。

noun.gloss: permission to read or write to a cloud storage bucket
noun.example: Control bucket access with IAM policies.
noun.example_zh: 使用 IAM 策略控制存储桶访问。

noun.gloss: permissions that control access to a cloud storage bucket
noun.example: Configure the bucket access permission to allow public read.
noun.example_zh: 配置存储桶访问权限以允许公共读取。

noun.example: Set the bucket ACL to grant read permissions.
noun.example_zh: 设置存储桶ACL以授予读取权限。
noun.gloss: Access Control List for a storage bucket

noun.example: I lost the bucket key, so I can't open the bucket.
noun.example_zh: 我弄丢了桶钥匙，所以打不开桶了。
noun.gloss: a key used to unlock a physical bucket

noun.example: Using a bucket-level encryption key can reduce overhead.
noun.example_zh: 使用存储桶级别的加密密钥可以减少开销。
noun.gloss: a key used for server-side encryption at the bucket level in cloud storage
a list of things a person hopes to do or achieve during their lifetime
noun.example: Skydiving is on my bucket list.
noun.example_zh: 跳伞在我的愿望清单上。

noun.gloss: a listing of storage buckets, especially in cloud object storage
noun.example: Use the CLI command to retrieve your bucket list.
noun.example_zh: 使用 CLI 命令获取存储桶列表。

noun.example: Specify the bucket location when creating a new cloud storage bucket.
noun.example_zh: 创建新的云存储桶时指定存储桶位置。
noun.gloss: the region where a cloud storage bucket resides

noun.example: You can view bucket metrics in the cloud storage console.
noun.example_zh: 您可以在云存储控制台中查看存储桶指标。
noun.gloss: a metric that monitors the performance or usage of a storage bucket
a CloudWatch alarm based on bucket metrics
noun.example: Create a bucket metric alarm for request rate.
noun.example_zh: 为请求速率创建存储桶指标警报。

noun.example: Each bucket object has a unique key.
noun.example_zh: 每个存储桶对象都有一个唯一的键。
noun.gloss: a file or data stored in a cloud storage bucket

noun.example: Only the bucket owner can delete the bucket.
noun.example_zh: 只有存储桶所有者可以删除存储桶。
noun.gloss: the account or entity that owns a storage bucket in a cloud storage service
access control settings for a storage bucket
noun.example: Check the bucket permissions before uploading.
noun.example_zh: 上传前检查存储桶权限。

noun.example: Apply the bucket policy to restrict public access.
noun.example_zh: 应用存储桶策略以限制公共访问。
noun.gloss: a policy attached to a cloud storage bucket controlling access

noun.example: The public bucket can be accessed by anyone.
noun.example_zh: 公共存储桶可以被任何人访问。
noun.gloss: A storage bucket that is publicly accessible.
A limitation or rule applied to a cloud storage bucket.
noun.example: The bucket restriction prevents public access.
noun.example_zh: 存储桶限制防止了公共访问。

noun.gloss: configuration options for a cloud storage bucket
noun.example: Change the bucket setting to enable versioning.
noun.example_zh: 更改存储桶设置以启用版本控制。

noun.gloss: a Uniform Resource Identifier that points to a storage bucket
noun.example: Access the object using the bucket URI.
noun.example_zh: 使用存储桶URI访问对象。

noun.gloss: a memory area used to cache data pages for faster access in databases
noun.example: A larger buffer pool can improve database performance.
noun.example_zh: 更大的缓冲池可以提高数据库性能。

noun.gloss: the amount of memory allocated for temporary data storage
noun.example: Adjust the buffer size for streaming.
noun.example_zh: 调整流传输的缓冲区大小。

noun.example: The latest update includes a bug fix for the login issue.
noun.example_zh: 最新更新包含对登录问题的错误修复。
noun.gloss: A correction made to a software bug

noun.example: The build application integrates with source control.
noun.example_zh: 构建应用与源代码控制集成。
noun.gloss: a software tool or application that automates the compilation and assembly of code

verb.example: We need to build an application that scales.
verb.example_zh: 我们需要构建一个可扩展的应用。
verb.gloss: to develop and create an application

noun.gloss: the output files produced by a build process
noun.example: The build artifact is deployed to the production server.
noun.example_zh: 构建产物被部署到生产服务器。

noun.gloss: a command that builds something
noun.example: Run the build command to compile the code.
noun.example_zh: 运行构建命令来编译代码。

noun.gloss: a command to build software
noun.example: The build command generates the executable.
noun.example_zh: 构建命令生成可执行文件。

noun.gloss: the environment where software builds are executed
noun.example: The build environment includes all necessary dependencies.
noun.example_zh: 构建环境包含所有必要的依赖项。

noun.gloss: An occurrence in a CI/CD build process.
noun.example: The build event triggered the next pipeline stage.
noun.example_zh: 构建事件触发了管道的下一个阶段。

noun.gloss: A structured description to match specific build events.
noun.example: The rule uses a build event pattern to filter notifications.
noun.example_zh: 该规则使用构建事件模式来过滤通知。

noun.gloss: the result of compiling code, such as artifacts
noun.example: Check the build output for errors.
noun.example_zh: 检查构建输出是否有错误。

noun.gloss: an automated process that compiles, tests, and deploys code
noun.example: The build pipeline fails if any unit test fails.
noun.example_zh: 如果任何单元测试失败，构建管道就会失败。

noun.example: The build process for the house took six months.
noun.example_zh: 这栋房子的建造过程花了六个月。
noun.gloss: a series of steps or actions taken to construct a physical structure
the sequence of tasks that compile, test, and package software code into an executable or deployable artifact
noun.example: The CI pipeline runs the build process on every commit.
noun.example_zh: 每次提交时，CI 管道都会运行构建过程。

noun.example: The build project was completed ahead of schedule.
noun.example_zh: 建造项目提前完成。
noun.gloss: a project that involves building something

noun.example: Create a build project for your application in the development environment.
noun.example_zh: 在开发环境中为应用程序创建一个构建项目。
noun.gloss: a configuration or project used to define how software is built, often in automated build systems
a document defining how to build a software project
noun.example: The build specification includes commands and artifacts.
noun.example_zh: 构建规范包括命令和输出文件。

noun.gloss: a set of tools and scripts to compile and package software
noun.example: The build system automatically runs tests before deployment.
noun.example_zh: 构建系统在部署前会自动运行测试。

noun.example: Optimizations can significantly reduce build time.
noun.example_zh: 优化可以显著减少构建时间。
noun.gloss: the time it takes to compile and package software

noun.example: You'll need a set of build tools to assemble the furniture.
noun.example_zh: 你需要一套建造工具来组装家具。
noun.gloss: a tool used for construction or assembly
a software tool that automates the process of compiling and packaging code
noun.example: Maven is a popular build tool for Java.
noun.example_zh: Maven是Java的一种流行构建工具。

noun.gloss: an API that facilitates building resources
noun.example: Use the Builder API to create the stack.
noun.example_zh: 使用构建器API来创建堆栈。

noun.example: The builder image includes all necessary build tools.
noun.example_zh: 构建器镜像包含了所有必要的构建工具。
noun.gloss: a pre-configured image used in a builder environment
an algorithm provided natively by a platform, not custom
noun.example: You can train a model using a built-in algorithm like XGBoost.
noun.example_zh: 您可以使用像XGBoost这样的内置算法来训练模型。

noun.gloss: inherent or included assistance or functionality
noun.example: The new smartphone has built-in support for wireless charging.
noun.example_zh: 新智能手机内置支持无线充电。

noun.gloss: native capability of a service or tool to handle a feature without external components
noun.example: AWS Lambda has built-in support for Java, Python, and Node.js runtimes.
noun.example_zh: AWS Lambda 内置支持 Java、Python 和 Node.js 运行时。

noun.gloss: the ability to temporarily increase compute performance under load
noun.example: Select a burstable performance instance type.
noun.example_zh: 选择一个突发性能实例类型。

noun.example: Use a burstable performance instance for workloads that don't need sustained high CPU.
noun.example_zh: 对于不需要持续高 CPU 的工作负载，使用突发性能实例。
noun.gloss: a type of cloud compute instance that provides a baseline level of CPU performance with the ability to burst above the baseline for short periods
a hardware or software interface for a bus system
noun.example: The bus interface connects the processor to memory.
noun.example_zh: 总线接口将处理器连接到内存。

noun.gloss: A software application used for business purposes.
noun.example: Microsoft Office is a common business application.
noun.example_zh: Microsoft Office是一种常见的商业应用。

noun.example: Migrate business applications to the cloud.
noun.example_zh: 将业务应用迁移到云端。
noun.gloss: a software application that supports business processes, typically deployed on enterprise infrastructure.
a day on which business is conducted, typically Monday to Friday excluding holidays
noun.example: The order will be delivered within three business days.
noun.example_zh: 订单将在三个工作日内送达。

noun.example: Our business hours are from 9 AM to 6 PM.
noun.example_zh: 我们的营业时间是从上午9点到下午6点。
noun.gloss: the time period during which a business is open
The effect or influence on business operations or outcomes.
noun.example: The company analyzed the business impact of the new regulation.
noun.example_zh: 公司分析了新规定对业务的影响。

noun.gloss: tools and practices for analyzing business data
noun.example: Our team uses business intelligence software to generate reports.
noun.example_zh: 我们的团队使用商业智能软件生成报告。

noun.gloss: technologies that analyze business information
noun.example: Amazon QuickSight is a business intelligence service.
noun.example_zh: Amazon QuickSight 是一项商业智能服务。

noun.gloss: the part of an application that handles the rules and workflows of the business
noun.example: Separate the business logic from the user interface.
noun.example_zh: 将业务逻辑与用户界面分离。

noun.gloss: a requirement or necessity of a company or organization
noun.example: The new feature was developed to fulfill a clear business need.
noun.example_zh: 开发新功能是为了满足明确的业务需求。

noun.example: We need to measure the business outcome of this project.
noun.example_zh: 我们需要衡量这个项目的业务成果。
noun.gloss: the result or effect of business activities or processes

noun.example: Cloud migration can drive better business outcomes.
noun.example_zh: 云迁移可以促进更好的业务成果。
noun.gloss: A measurable result of a technology initiative that impacts business performance
a need or condition that must be met for a business objective
noun.example: We need to analyze business requirements before starting.
noun.example_zh: 在开始之前，我们需要分析业务需求。

noun.gloss: the functional and non-functional needs for a cloud solution from a business perspective
noun.example: Gather business requirements for the cloud migration.
noun.example_zh: 收集云迁移的业务需求。

noun.gloss: assistance for business operations
noun.example: The company offers business support services.
noun.example_zh: 公司提供业务支持服务。

noun.example: Business Support includes faster response times and priority access.
noun.example_zh: 业务支持包括更快的响应时间和优先访问权限。
noun.gloss: a tier of technical support for business-critical workloads, typically offered by cloud providers
noun.meaning: 业务支持（云服务支持计划级别）

noun.gloss: a distinct part of a company that operates as a separate entity
noun.example: Each business unit is responsible for its own budget.
noun.example_zh: 每个业务部门对自己的预算负责。

noun.gloss: the worth of a business in terms of economic and strategic benefits
noun.example: The project demonstrated clear business value.
noun.example_zh: 该项目展示了明确的商业价值。

noun.gloss: a data structure that stores a contiguous sequence of bytes
noun.example: The byte array holds the binary data.
noun.example_zh: 字节数组保存二进制数据。

noun.example: Upload the CA certificate to establish a trusted connection.
noun.example_zh: 上传 CA 证书以建立受信任的连接。
noun.gloss: a digital certificate that belongs to a Certificate Authority and is used to verify the identity of the CA and the signatures on other certificates
configuration for how a content delivery network handles caching of content
noun.example: You can define multiple cache behaviors for different URL paths.
noun.example_zh: 您可以为不同的 URL 路径定义多个缓存行为。

noun.gloss: a group of cache nodes that provide a distributed cache
noun.example: The cache cluster stores session data.
noun.example_zh: 缓存集群存储会话数据。

noun.gloss: a unique identifier used to retrieve cached data
noun.example: The cache key is based on the URL.
noun.example_zh: 缓存键基于URL。

noun.example: Increasing the number of cache nodes can reduce database load.
noun.example_zh: 增加缓存节点可以减少数据库负载。
noun.gloss: a node in a distributed caching system that stores frequently accessed data to improve performance

noun.example: Define a cache policy for your content delivery network.
noun.example_zh: 为你的内容分发网络定义缓存策略。
noun.gloss: rules governing caching behavior
the amount of data that can be stored in a cache
noun.example: Adjust the cache size to improve performance.
noun.example_zh: 调整缓存大小以提升性能。

noun.gloss: Storage used for caching data to improve access speed
noun.example: The application uses cache storage to reduce latency.
noun.example_zh: 该应用程序使用缓存存储来减少延迟。

noun.gloss: a logical connection between two endpoints in a VoIP call
noun.example: Each call leg represents a segment of the communication.
noun.example_zh: 每个通话段代表通信的一个部分。

noun.gloss: a log of a telephone conversation
noun.example: I need to review the call record for the customer complaint.
noun.example_zh: 我需要查看客户投诉的通话记录。

noun.gloss: a record of a voice or video call in telephony systems
noun.example: Amazon Connect stores call records for analysis.
noun.example_zh: Amazon Connect 存储通话记录以供分析。

noun.gloss: a function passed as an argument to be executed later
noun.example: Implement a callback function to handle the response.
noun.example_zh: 实现一个回调函数来处理响应。

noun.gloss: a URL where an application receives responses or notifications
noun.example: Set the callback URL for the webhook.
noun.example_zh: 为webhook设置回调URL。

noun.gloss: a message sent as part of a promotional campaign
noun.example: The campaign message reached millions.
noun.example_zh: 活动消息触及了数百万人。

noun.gloss: a message used in marketing campaigns, often automated
noun.example: We configured the campaign message in the marketing platform.
noun.example_zh: 我们在营销平台中配置了活动消息。

noun.example: You can use the canonical ID to uniquely identify a user.
noun.example_zh: 你可以使用规范ID来唯一标识用户。
noun.gloss: a unique, fixed identifier that is used to refer to an entity in a consistent manner across systems.

noun.example: Create a CNAME record to map the canonical name.
noun.example_zh: 创建 CNAME 记录以映射规范名称。
noun.gloss: the official or fully qualified name for a resource, especially in DNS

noun.example: Use the canonical name of the file to avoid symlink issues.
noun.example_zh: 使用文件的规范名称以避免符号链接问题。
noun.gloss: the official or standard name for an entity, often resolving to a fully qualified name

noun.example_zh: 模板引擎在运行时解析动态值。

an initial or earlier release of something
noun.example: This is an early version of the software.
noun.example_zh: 这是软件的早期版本。

noun.gloss: the ability to reach or use something without difficulty
noun.example: The library provides easy access to a vast collection of research papers.
noun.example_zh: 图书馆提供了便捷访问大量研究论文的途径。

noun.gloss: a design principle or feature that allows users or services to quickly reach a resource without barriers
noun.example: We implemented easy access to the storage bucket through a signed URL.
noun.example_zh: 我们通过签名 URL 实现了对存储桶的便捷访问。

noun.gloss: a public container registry service provided by AWS
noun.example: Push the image to ECR Public for public access.
noun.example_zh: 将镜像推送到ECR Public以实现公共访问。

noun.gloss: a cache located at the edge of a network, such as a CDN
noun.example: The edge cache reduces latency for global users.
noun.example_zh: 边缘缓存减少了全球用户的延迟。

noun.gloss: a client device at the edge of a network
noun.example: Deploy the service to edge clients.
noun.example_zh: 将服务部署到边缘客户端。

noun.example: Deploy the software to edge devices in the factory.
noun.example_zh: 将软件部署到工厂的边缘设备上。
noun.gloss: a device located at the edge of a network that performs data collection, processing, or forwarding
a computing job executed at the edge of a network
noun.example: The edge job processes data from sensors.
noun.example_zh: 边缘作业处理来自传感器的数据。

noun.example: Content delivery networks serve content from edge locations worldwide.
noun.example_zh: 内容分发网络从全球边缘站点提供内容。
noun.gloss: a site in a content delivery network where cached content is served close to end users
a component or service that manages devices and applications at the network edge
noun.example: Edge Manager simplifies the deployment of edge devices.
noun.example_zh: 边缘管理器简化了边缘设备的部署。

noun.gloss: the right to modify or change something
noun.example: You need edit permission to update the document.
noun.example_zh: 你需要编辑权限才能更新文档。

noun.gloss: authorization to modify a resource or configuration
noun.example: Assign edit permission to the developer role.
noun.example_zh: 将编辑权限分配给开发者角色。

noun.example: Elastic compute helps you handle unexpected traffic spikes without over-provisioning.
noun.example_zh: 弹性计算可帮助您应对突发流量高峰，而无需过度配置。
noun.gloss: Computing capacity that can automatically scale up or down based on demand, typically in cloud environments.
the arrangement of items in a graded order
noun.example: The document's element hierarchy makes editing easier.
noun.example_zh: 文档的元素层次结构使编辑更容易。

noun.gloss: the tree-like organization of components in a system or UI
noun.example: Understand the element hierarchy to style the webpage.
noun.example_zh: 了解元素层级以便对网页进行样式设计。

noun.gloss: a reference to a specific element in a template or document
noun.example: Use an element reference to access the value of another resource.
noun.example_zh: 使用元素引用访问另一个资源的值。

noun.example: The elliptic curve provides strong security.
noun.example_zh: 椭圆曲线提供了强大的安全性。
noun.gloss: a type of algebraic curve studied in number theory and used in cryptography

noun.example: Elliptic curve ephemeral key exchange ensures forward secrecy.
noun.example_zh: 椭圆曲线临时密钥交换确保了前向保密。
noun.gloss: an ephemeral key exchange using elliptic curve cryptography, often ECDHE
noun.meaning: 椭圆曲线临时密钥交换

noun.example: Please type your email address.
noun.example_zh: 请输入您的电子邮件地址。
noun.gloss: unique identifier for an email mailbox

collocations: send notifications via the email channel

noun.gloss: a method of communication using email
noun.example: We use the email channel for marketing.
noun.example_zh: 我们使用电子邮件渠道进行营销。

noun.example: The email channel is configured in the notification service.
noun.example_zh: 已在通知服务中配置电子邮件通道。
noun.gloss: a communication channel that uses email for delivering messages from an application or service
a software application used to access and manage a user's email
noun.example: I prefer using a desktop email client rather than webmail.
noun.example_zh: 比起网页邮箱，我更喜欢使用桌面电子邮件客户端。

noun.example: Configure your email client to use an SMTP server for outgoing mail.
noun.example_zh: 将您的电子邮件客户端配置为使用 SMTP 服务器发送外发邮件。
noun.gloss: an application or service that sends, receives, and manages emails, often configured with SMTP/IMAP
metadata at the beginning of an email message
noun.example: Check the email header for the sender's IP.
noun.example_zh: 检查邮件头以获取发件人的 IP。

noun.example: I received an email message from my boss.
noun.example_zh: 我收到了老板的电子邮件消息。
noun.gloss: a message sent via email

noun.example: I received an email notification about the meeting.
noun.example_zh: 我收到了关于会议的电子邮件通知。
noun.gloss: a notification sent via email
a company that offers email services
noun.example: Gmail is a popular email provider.
noun.example_zh: Gmail 是一个受欢迎的电子邮件提供商。

noun.gloss: a service that provides email infrastructure
noun.example: The email provider's SMTP server is reliable.
noun.example_zh: 该电子邮件提供商的 SMTP 服务器很可靠。

noun.gloss: a server that handles email sending and receiving
noun.example: Set up an email server for sending notifications.
noun.example_zh: 设置电子邮件服务器以发送通知。

noun.gloss: a pre-designed format for email messages
noun.example: Use this email template for welcome messages.
noun.example_zh: 使用此邮件模板来发送欢迎消息。

noun.example: Create an email template to standardize your communications.
noun.example_zh: 创建一个电子邮件模板以标准化您的通信。
noun.gloss: a template used for sending formatted emails
An array data structure with zero elements
noun.example: Initialize the variable as an empty array.
noun.example_zh: 将该变量初始化为一个空数组。

noun.gloss: a folder with no files
noun.example: I deleted the empty directory.
noun.example_zh: 我删除了空目录。

noun.gloss: a directory containing no files or subdirectories
noun.example: The script checks for empty directories.
noun.example_zh: 脚本检查空目录。

noun.gloss: A string that contains no characters, often represented as '' or "" in programming.
noun.example: Check if the input field contains an empty string.
noun.example_zh: 检查输入字段是否为空字符串。

noun.gloss: a value that contains nothing or no data
noun.example: Please enter a non-empty value in the required field.
noun.example_zh: 请在必填字段中输入一个非空值。

noun.gloss: absence of data in a variable or field
noun.example: Handle empty values to avoid runtime errors.
noun.example_zh: 处理空值以避免运行时错误。

verb.gloss: to allow someone to enter or use something
verb.example: Please enable access to the building for visitors.
verb.example_zh: 请允许访客进入大楼。

verb.example: You must enable access to the storage bucket.
verb.example_zh: 你必须启用对存储桶的访问权限。
verb.gloss: to grant permission to access a resource

verb.example: You must encrypt the data before uploading it.
verb.example_zh: 您必须在上传之前加密数据。
verb.gloss: to apply encryption to data

verb.example: You can encrypt the file system using a key management service.
verb.example_zh: 您可以使用密钥管理服务加密文件系统。
verb.gloss: to apply encryption to a file system or its data
to convert a message into a coded form to hide its content
verb.example: Please encrypt the message before sending.
verb.example_zh: 请先加密消息再发送。

verb.gloss: to apply a cryptographic algorithm to a message for security
verb.example: Use the library to encrypt the message with AES.
verb.example_zh: 使用该库用AES加密消息。

verb.example: Encrypt the object before uploading it to the bucket.
verb.example_zh: 在上传到存储桶之前加密对象。
verb.gloss: to encrypt an object at rest or in transit
to apply encryption to a snapshot of data
verb.example: You can encrypt the snapshot for security.
verb.example_zh: 你可以加密该快照以确保安全。

verb.example: Encrypt the volume to protect data at rest.
verb.example_zh: 对卷进行加密以保护静态数据。
verb.gloss: to apply encryption to a storage volume

noun.gloss: a set of rules for encrypting data
noun.example: This app uses a strong encryption algorithm to protect your messages.
noun.example_zh: 该应用使用强加密算法保护你的消息。

noun.gloss: a set of rules for encrypting data
noun.example: Select an encryption algorithm for your S3 bucket.
noun.example_zh: 为你的 S3 存储桶选择加密算法。

noun.gloss: a client program that handles encryption and decryption of data
noun.example: The encryption client automatically secures your data before upload.
noun.example_zh: 加密客户端在上传前自动保护您的数据。

noun.example: Always include an encryption context when encrypting data.
noun.example_zh: 加密数据时始终包含加密上下文。
noun.gloss: A set of key-value pairs that provide additional authenticated data for encryption operations.
A data field that is stored or transmitted in an encrypted format.
noun.example: Mark the column as an encryption field.
noun.example_zh: 将该列标记为加密字段。

noun.gloss: a piece of information used in cryptographic encryption
noun.example: Store the encryption key in a secure location.
noun.example_zh: 将加密密钥存储在安全位置。

noun.example: Select an appropriate encryption method for the data.
noun.example_zh: 为数据选择适当的加密方法。
noun.gloss: a technique or algorithm used for encrypting data
a mode of operation for encryption algorithms
noun.example: Select an encryption mode that suits your security needs.
noun.example_zh: 选择适合您安全需求的加密模式。

noun.gloss: configuration that enables data encryption
noun.example: Check the encryption setting of the storage bucket.
noun.example_zh: 检查存储桶的加密设置。

noun.gloss: a system or method for encrypting data
noun.example: The company offers an end-to-end encryption solution.
noun.example_zh: 该公司提供端到端的加密解决方案。

noun.gloss: a specification for encrypting data to ensure security
noun.example: The data must be encrypted using an approved encryption standard.
noun.example_zh: 必须使用经批准的加密标准对数据进行加密。

noun.example: You can view the encryption status of your storage volumes.
noun.example_zh: 您可以查看存储卷的加密状态。
noun.gloss: Indication of whether data or a resource is encrypted.
the date on which something ends or finishes
noun.example: The project's end date is next Friday.
noun.example_zh: 项目的结束日期是下周五。

noun.example: The meeting's end time is 3 PM.
noun.example_zh: 会议结束时间是下午 3 点。
noun.gloss: the time when an event or activity finishes
a secure communication method where only the communicating users can read the messages
noun.example: This messaging app uses end-to-end encryption.
noun.example_zh: 这个通讯应用使用端到端加密。

noun.gloss: a cryptographic system where data is encrypted on the sender's system and only decrypted by the recipient
noun.example: Implementing end-to-end encryption requires key exchange.
noun.example_zh: 实现端到端加密需要密钥交换。

noun.gloss: the specification of an API endpoint, including its URL and methods
noun.example: Add an endpoint definition for the new service.
noun.example_zh: 为新服务添加端点定义。

noun.example: The endpoint policy restricts access to only authorized resources.
noun.example_zh: 端点策略仅限制对授权资源的访问。
noun.gloss: a policy that controls access to services through a network endpoint
a classification of network endpoints
noun.example: Select the endpoint type for your VPC.
noun.example_zh: 为您的VPC选择端点类型。

noun.gloss: the URL address of a service endpoint
noun.example: Specify the endpoint URL for the API.
noun.example_zh: 指定 API 的端点 URL。

noun.gloss: the classification of an engine based on its design or fuel type
noun.example: Select the engine type for your database instance.
noun.example_zh: 为数据库实例选择引擎类型。

noun.gloss: the specific release number of a software engine, especially for databases or runtimes
noun.example: Upgrade the engine version to the latest release.
noun.example_zh: 将引擎版本升级到最新版本。

noun.example: Enhanced security is achieved by enabling multi-factor authentication.
noun.example_zh: 通过启用多因素认证来增强安全性。
noun.gloss: Increased level of protection against threats, often through additional measures.

noun.example: You can find anyone's email in the enterprise directory.
noun.example_zh: 您可以在企业目录中找到任何人的电子邮件。
noun.gloss: a central list of employees, departments, and resources within an organization

noun.example: The IT team configured the enterprise directory to sync with Active Directory.
noun.example_zh: IT团队配置了企业目录以与Active Directory同步。

a premium version of software designed for large organizations, often with advanced features
noun.example: Upgrade to Enterprise Edition for high availability features.
noun.example_zh: 升级到企业版以获得高可用性功能。

noun.example: Enterprise support helps businesses resolve common issues quickly.
noun.example_zh: 企业支持帮助公司快速解决常见问题。
noun.gloss: assistance provided to business customers, typically for product usage or general troubleshooting
the process of identifying named entities in text
noun.example: Use entity detection to extract names and locations.
noun.example_zh: 使用实体检测来提取名称和位置。

noun.example: Use the entity inspector to examine all resources.
noun.example_zh: 使用实体检查器检查所有资源。
noun.gloss: a tool for inspecting entities in a system

noun.example: The entity outliner extracts key subjects from the document.
noun.example_zh: 实体大纲生成器从文档中提取关键主体。
noun.gloss: a tool or algorithm that identifies and outlines entities in text or data
permissions associated with an entity in a system
noun.example: Define entity permissions to control access levels.
noun.example_zh: 定义实体权限以控制访问级别。

noun.gloss: the NLP task of identifying entities in text
noun.example: Entity recognition extracts people, places, and organizations.
noun.example_zh: 实体识别提取人物、地点和组织。

noun.gloss: A natural language processing system that identifies named entities in text.
noun.example: The entity recognizer extracted company names and dates from the documents.
noun.example_zh: 实体识别器从文档中提取了公司名称和日期。

noun.gloss: A system in software architecture that manages entities, commonly part of the Entity-Component-System pattern.
noun.example: The entity system handles all game objects.
noun.example_zh: 实体系统处理所有游戏对象。

noun.gloss: A place of entrance or a starting point.
noun.example: The main entry point of the building is on the north side.
noun.example_zh: 大楼的主要入口在北侧。

noun.gloss: The starting point of a program's execution.
noun.example: The main function serves as the entry point.
noun.example_zh: 主函数作为入口点。

noun.gloss: encryption that uses a data key wrapped with a master key
noun.example: Envelope encryption protects data at scale.
noun.example_zh: 信封加密可大规模保护数据。

noun.example: The CI/CD pipeline automates environment creation for each branch.
noun.example_zh: CI/CD管道为每个分支自动化环境创建。
noun.gloss: The act of provisioning a computational environment, such as a development, testing, or production environment.
a variable that defines some aspect of the environment in which a process runs
noun.example: Set the PATH environment variable to include the new tool.
noun.example_zh: 设置 PATH 环境变量以包含新工具。

noun.example: Envoy proxy is used as a sidecar in service mesh.
noun.example_zh: Envoy 代理在服务网格中被用作 sidecar。
noun.gloss: a high-performance proxy designed for cloud-native applications

noun.example: Use Ephemeral Diffie-Hellman to achieve perfect forward secrecy.
noun.example_zh: 使用临时 Diffie-Hellman 以实现完美前向保密。

noun.example: Use ephemeral Diffie-Hellman DHE for enhanced security.
noun.example_zh: 使用临时 Diffie-Hellman DHE 以增强安全性。

temporary storage that is lost when the instance or container is stopped or terminated
noun.example: Use ephemeral storage for caching temporary application data.
noun.example_zh: 使用临时存储缓存应用程序临时数据。

noun.gloss: the number of seconds since January 1, 1970 (Unix epoch)
noun.example: Convert the date to epoch time for the API payload.
noun.example_zh: 将日期转换为纪元时间以便放入 API 载荷中。

noun.example: The app displayed an error code when it crashed.
noun.example_zh: 应用崩溃时显示了一个错误代码。
noun.gloss: a code that indicates an error
a state in which something is not functioning correctly
noun.example: The system enters an error condition when the disk is full.
noun.example_zh: 当磁盘已满时，系统会进入错误状况。

noun.gloss: a specific set of circumstances indicating a failure or exception in a program
noun.example: The API returns an error condition if the request is invalid.
noun.example_zh: 如果请求无效，API 会返回错误条件。

noun.example: Implement robust error handling in your application.
noun.example_zh: 在应用程序中实现健壮的错误处理。
noun.gloss: mechanisms in software to manage and recover from errors during execution

noun.example: Developers check the error log to debug application crashes.
noun.example_zh: 开发人员检查错误日志以调试应用程序崩溃。
noun.gloss: a file that records error messages generated by software or hardware
a notification that something went wrong
noun.example: I keep getting an error message when I try to log in.
noun.example_zh: 我尝试登录时总收到错误信息。

noun.gloss: a computer-generated message indicating a fault or problem
noun.example: The API returned an error message with status code 500.
noun.example_zh: API返回了状态码500的错误消息。

noun.gloss: The frequency of errors
noun.example: The factory aims to reduce the error rate.
noun.example_zh: 工厂致力于降低错误率。

noun.gloss: The proportion of failed requests or operations
noun.example: Monitor the error rate to detect anomalies.
noun.example_zh: 监控错误率以检测异常。

noun.gloss: a message generated by a system or API indicating a failure
noun.example: The API returned a 404 error response.
noun.example_zh: API 返回了 404 错误响应。

noun.gloss: the action of retrying an operation after an error
noun.example: The system implements an error retry mechanism.
noun.example_zh: 系统实现了错误重试机制。

noun.gloss: a limit on the number or rate of errors before an action is triggered
noun.example: If the error threshold is crossed, the system will alert you.
noun.example_zh: 如果超过错误阈值，系统会发出警报。

noun.gloss: a strategy for raising an issue to higher authority
noun.example: We need an escalation plan for customer complaints.
noun.example_zh: 我们需要一个客户投诉的升级计划。

noun.gloss: a process to escalate incidents in IT operations
noun.example: The escalation plan ensures critical alerts reach the on-call engineer.
noun.example_zh: 升级计划确保关键警报送达值班工程师。

noun.gloss: a character that changes the meaning of the character that follows it, often used in programming and data formats to include special characters

noun.example_zh: 在许多语言中，反斜杠用作转义字符，因此 \" 表示字符串内的双引号。

verb.gloss: to calculate the approximate cost

verb.example_zh: 在开始项目前我们需要估算成本。

noun.gloss: a job that performs extraction, transformation, and loading of data
noun.example: Schedule the ETL job to run nightly.
noun.example_zh: 安排ETL作业每晚运行。

noun.gloss: A script that performs Extract, Transform, Load processes on data.
noun.example: The ETL script cleans and loads the data into the warehouse.
noun.example_zh: ETL 脚本清洗数据并将其加载到数据仓库。

verb.gloss: to assess the status or metrics of a target
verb.example: The load balancer evaluates target health before sending requests.
verb.example_zh: 负载均衡器在发送请求之前会评估目标健康状况。

verb.gloss: to assess the health status of targets in load balancing or auto scaling
verb.example: The load balancer evaluates target health before routing traffic.
verb.example_zh: 负载均衡器在路由流量前评估目标运行状况。

noun.gloss: the logical process for assessing something
noun.example: The evaluation logic determines which policy applies.
noun.example_zh: 评估逻辑决定了应用哪项策略。

noun.gloss: a standard of measurement used to assess the performance of a model or system
noun.example: Accuracy is a common evaluation metric for classification tasks.
noun.example_zh: 准确率是分类任务常用的评估指标。

noun.gloss: A mode in which a system or model is tested or assessed without changing production data.
noun.example: Switch to evaluation mode before running the tests.
noun.example_zh: 在运行测试之前切换到评估模式。

noun.gloss: a timeframe for testing or assessment before purchase
noun.example: You can use the product free during the evaluation period.
noun.example_zh: 在评估期内您可以免费使用该产品。

noun.example: The software is available for a 30-day evaluation period.
noun.example_zh: 该软件提供30天的评估期。
noun.gloss: a period for testing a service or software
the outcome of an evaluation
noun.example: We are waiting for the evaluation results.
noun.example_zh: 我们在等待评价结果。

noun.gloss: output from an evaluation, such as a model's performance
noun.example: The evaluation results indicate high accuracy.
noun.example_zh: 评估结果表明高准确率。

noun.gloss: activity related to an event

noun.example_zh: 系统记录事件活动。

noun.gloss: records of user or system events in a service
noun.example: Filter event activity by region.
noun.example_zh: 按区域筛选事件活动。

noun.gloss: a system that enables event-driven communication between software components
noun.example: The service sends events to an event bus.
noun.example_zh: 该服务将事件发送到事件总线。

noun.gloss: the endpoint or service where an event notification is sent
noun.example: Configure an SNS topic as the event destination for your function.
noun.example_zh: 将 SNS 主题配置为函数的事件目标。

noun.gloss: The process of identifying significant occurrences from data, such as anomalies or triggers.
noun.example: Event detection algorithms can flag unusual activity.
noun.example_zh: 事件检测算法可以标记异常活动。

noun.example: You can view the event history to see all actions recorded in the system.
noun.example_zh: 您可以查看事件历史以了解系统中记录的所有操作。
noun.gloss: A log of events that occurred in a system

noun.example: The event log shows the application error.
noun.example_zh: 事件日志显示了应用程序错误。
noun.gloss: system event log for troubleshooting
a message describing an occurrence
noun.example: I received an event message about the schedule change.

noun.gloss: a modification made to a file
noun.example: I noticed a file change in the shared folder.
noun.example_zh: 我发现共享文件夹中有个文件更改。

noun.gloss: an event indicating that a file has been created, modified, or deleted in a system
noun.example: Set up a trigger on file change events.
noun.example_zh: 对文件变更事件设置触发器。

noun.gloss: the information stored inside a file
noun.example: Check the file content before opening it.
noun.example_zh: 在打开文件之前检查文件内容。

noun.gloss: the data contained in a digital file
noun.example: The file content is encrypted for security.
noun.example_zh: 文件内容已加密以确保安全。

noun.example: The program reads file data from the disk.
noun.example_zh: 程序从磁盘读取文件数据。
noun.gloss: data stored in a file

noun.example: Cloud file storage services are designed for file data that requires shared access across multiple instances.
noun.example_zh: 云文件存储服务专为需要跨多个实例共享访问的文件数据而设计。
noun.gloss: data stored in a file-based storage system, often contrasted with block data or object data
noun.meaning: 文件数据（与块存储、对象存储相对）

noun.gloss: the act or service of transferring files to a recipient
noun.example: We offer express file delivery for large documents.
noun.example_zh: 我们提供大文件的特快传送服务。

noun.example: Cloud storage services ensure durable file delivery with high reliability.
noun.example_zh: 云存储服务确保持久可靠的文件交付，具有高可靠性。
noun.gloss: the process of reliably delivering files to a destination, often used in log collection, data pipelines, or content distribution

noun.example: Each file entry shows the name and size.
noun.example_zh: 每个文件条目显示名称和大小。
noun.gloss: a record or listing in a file or directory

noun.example: I use file explorer to organize my documents.
noun.example_zh: 我用文件浏览器来整理我的文档。
noun.gloss: A program that allows users to view and manage files and folders on a computer.

noun.example: Navigate to the directory in file explorer.
noun.example_zh: 在文件浏览器中导航到该目录。
noun.gloss: A software utility for browsing and manipulating the file system.

noun.example: Rename the log file to have a .log file extension.
noun.example_zh: 将日志文件重命名为 .log 扩展名。
noun.gloss: a suffix that helps the operating system determine how to handle the file

noun.example: Select the file format before exporting the data.
noun.example_zh: 在导出数据前选择文件格式。
noun.gloss: the structure and encoding of a file

noun.example: Deploy a file gateway to extend on-premises file storage to the cloud.
noun.example_zh: 部署文件网关以将本地文件存储扩展到云端。
noun.gloss: a gateway that provides file-based access to cloud storage, typically used to connect on-premises environments to cloud storage services
a set of operations for reading, writing, and managing files in a system
noun.example: The operating system provides a file interface for applications.
noun.example_zh: 操作系统为应用程序提供文件接口。

noun.example: Please enter the file location (e.g., /home/user/doc).
noun.example_zh: 请输入文件位置（例如 /home/user/doc）。
noun.gloss: the path or address of a file in a system
data describing a file, like author or date
noun.example: The photo includes file metadata such as camera settings.
noun.example_zh: 照片包含文件元数据，例如相机设置。

noun.gloss: system-level information about a file
noun.example: The system preserves file metadata during transfer.
noun.example_zh: 系统在传输过程中保留文件元数据。

noun.gloss: permission settings that control read, write, and execute access to a file
noun.example: Set the file mode to 644 for read-only access.
noun.example_zh: 将文件模式设置为 644 以获得只读访问权限。

noun.gloss: an action performed on a file, such as reading or writing
noun.example: The file operation was successful.
noun.example_zh: 文件操作成功。

noun.gloss: a low-level operation on a file in a computing system
noun.example: Monitor file operations on the server.
noun.example_zh: 监控服务器上的文件操作。

noun.example: Please provide the full file path to the document.
noun.example_zh: 请提供文档的完整文件路径。
noun.gloss: The location of a file in a directory hierarchy, such as C:\Users\name\document.txt.
the permissions assigned to a file that determine who can read, write, or execute it
noun.example: Check the file permission before you try to open it.
noun.example_zh: 在尝试打开文件之前，请检查文件权限。

noun.gloss: an access control setting for a file in a cloud storage or file system
noun.example: Configure the file permission for the bucket object to public read.
noun.example_zh: 将存储桶对象的文件权限配置为公共读取。

noun.gloss: A computer responsible for storage and retrieval of files for network users.
noun.example: Set up a file server for shared office documents.
noun.example_zh: 为共享办公文档设置一个文件服务器。

noun.gloss: a shared file system or folder accessible over a network
noun.example: Mount the file share on your instance.
noun.example_zh: 在实例上挂载文件共享。

noun.example: The file size limit for upload is 10 MB.
noun.example_zh: 上传的文件大小限制为10MB。
noun.gloss: the size of a file measured in bytes or other units

noun.example: NFS provides scalable file storage for many applications.
noun.example_zh: NFS为许多应用提供可扩展的文件存储。
noun.gloss: a storage system that organizes files in a hierarchical structure, often provided as a cloud service
the way files and folders are organized on a device
noun.example: Explain the file structure of the project.
noun.example_zh: 解释项目的文件结构。

noun.gloss: the hierarchical layout of directories and files in a filesystem or project
noun.example: The file structure must follow the convention for the deployment to work.
noun.example_zh: 文件结构必须遵循约定才能使部署生效。

noun.gloss: the system for organizing and storing files on a computer
noun.example: My laptop's file system is almost full.
noun.example_zh: 我的笔记本电脑的文件系统快满了。

noun.gloss: a method and data structure that an operating system uses to control how data is stored and retrieved
noun.example: The instance uses the XFS file system.
noun.example_zh: 该实例使用 XFS 文件系统。

noun.example: Enter the file system ID to mount the filesystem.
noun.example_zh: 输入文件系统ID来挂载文件系统。
noun.gloss: a unique identifier for a file system
a policy that controls access to a file system
noun.example: Apply the file system policy to restrict access.
noun.example_zh: 应用文件系统策略以限制访问。

noun.example: Use SFTP for secure file transfer.
noun.example_zh: 使用SFTP进行安全文件传输。
noun.gloss: the transmission of files over a network using protocols like FTP or SFTP

noun.example: Not all file types are supported.
noun.example_zh: 并非所有文件类型都受支持。
noun.gloss: a category or format of a file, e.g., PDF, JPEG

noun.example: The program determines the file type by its extension.
noun.example_zh: 该程序通过扩展名确定文件类型。
noun.gloss: a classification of files based on format, e.g., PDF, JPEG
the action of transferring a file from one computer to another, often over the internet
noun.example: The file upload was cancelled.
noun.example_zh: 文件上传已取消。

noun.gloss: the process of sending a file to a cloud storage service or API
noun.example: Use multipart file upload for large objects.
noun.example_zh: 对于大型对象使用分片文件上传。

noun.gloss: a user interface element that allows filtering data
noun.example: The filter control lets you narrow down search results.
noun.example_zh: 过滤器控件可让您缩小搜索结果范围。

noun.gloss: A set of conditions used to narrow down a list of items.
noun.example: Apply the filter criteria to find matching records.
noun.example_zh: 应用筛选条件查找匹配的记录。

noun.gloss: A set of conditions used to narrow down a list of items.
noun.example: The database query uses filter criteria to return relevant results.
noun.example_zh: 数据库查询使用筛选条件返回相关结果。

noun.example: Please define the filter criterion for the search.
noun.example_zh: 请定义搜索的筛选条件。
noun.gloss: a standard or rule used to select or exclude items

noun.example: You can add a filter criterion to list only running virtual machines.
noun.example_zh: 你可以添加筛选条件，只列出运行中的虚拟机。
noun.gloss: a condition used to filter resources or API results in cloud services
a logical statement used to filter data
noun.example: The filter expression returns only items with a price less than 50.
noun.example_zh: 该筛选表达式仅返回价格低于50的项目。

noun.gloss: a pattern used to filter data or logs
noun.example: You can use a filter pattern to exclude irrelevant log entries.
noun.example_zh: 您可以使用筛选模式排除不相关的日志条目。

noun.gloss: rules that determine which messages or events pass through a subscription
noun.example: Set up a subscription filter policy to receive only relevant messages.
noun.example_zh: 设置订阅筛选策略以仅接收相关消息。

noun.example: The filter result shows only relevant items.
noun.example_zh: 过滤结果仅显示相关项目。
noun.gloss: the output after applying a filter

noun.example: The API returns a filter result based on the query parameters.
noun.example_zh: API 根据查询参数返回过滤结果。
noun.gloss: the output after applying a filter in a technical context
a set of criteria used to select or exclude data
noun.example: Create a filter rule to allow only HTTPS traffic.
noun.example_zh: 创建一条过滤规则以仅允许 HTTPS 流量。

noun.gloss: the end outcome of a process
noun.example: The final result exceeded our expectations.
noun.example_zh: 最终结果超出了我们的预期。

noun.example: You can choose to create a final snapshot when deleting a cloud database instance.
noun.example_zh: 在删除云数据库实例时，您可以选择创建最终快照。
noun.gloss: the last snapshot taken of a database or volume before termination
the process of managing money and investments
noun.example: Good financial management is essential for a business.
noun.example_zh: 良好的财务管理对业务至关重要。

noun.example: Use attribute-based access control for fine-grained access control.
noun.example_zh: 使用基于属性的访问控制实现细粒度访问控制。
noun.gloss: access control that restricts permissions at a very specific level

noun.example: Ensure the module is certified to FIPS 140-2.
noun.example_zh: 确保模块通过FIPS 140-2认证。
noun.gloss: a US government security standard for cryptographic modules
a network endpoint that complies with Federal Information Processing Standards
noun.example: Configure your service to use a FIPS endpoint.
noun.example_zh: 将服务配置为使用 FIPS 端点。

noun.example: A firewall manager allows administrators to define and enforce firewall policies across the network.
noun.example_zh: 防火墙管理器让管理员能够定义并强制执行网络中的防火墙策略。
noun.gloss: a tool or service that centralizes the configuration and management of firewall rules
a set of rules that control network traffic through a firewall
noun.example: Apply a strict firewall policy to protect the server.
noun.example_zh: 应用严格的防火墙策略来保护服务器。

noun.gloss: a rule that defines allowed or denied network traffic through a firewall
noun.example: Define a firewall rule to block all incoming SSH traffic from unknown IPs.
noun.example_zh: 定义防火墙规则以阻止来自未知IP的所有传入SSH流量。

noun.gloss: a binary file containing firmware to be loaded onto hardware
noun.example: Download the firmware image for the device.
noun.example_zh: 下载设备的固件映像。

noun.gloss: a software program that updates the low-level control software of a hardware device
noun.example: The firewall requires a firmware update to patch the security vulnerability.
noun.example_zh: 防火墙需要固件更新以修补安全漏洞。

noun.gloss: the name given to a person at birth, before the family name
noun.example: Please enter your first name.
noun.example_zh: 请输入您的名字。

noun.example: Cloud storage services often include a flexible retrieval class for archival data.
noun.example_zh: 云存储服务通常提供用于归档数据的灵活检索类别。
noun.gloss: a storage retrieval option that offers flexibility in access speed and cost, typically used for infrequently accessed data
a block in a flow diagram or workflow
noun.example: Add a flow block to the contact flow.
noun.example_zh: 在联系流中添加流程块。

noun.example: Import a flow definition to configure your automated process.
noun.example_zh: 导入流程定义以配置您的自动化流程。
noun.gloss: a description of a workflow's steps and logic, used in automated systems

noun.example: Drag actions onto the flow designer canvas.
noun.example_zh: 将操作拖到流程设计器画布上。
noun.gloss: a visual tool for designing workflows and automation
a diagram representing a process
noun.example: Create a flow graph to visualize the workflow.
noun.example_zh: 创建一个流程图来可视化工作流。

noun.gloss: a graphical representation of data flow
noun.example: The compiler generates a flow graph for optimization.
noun.example_zh: 编译器生成流图以进行优化。

noun.gloss: logs that capture IP traffic information
noun.example: Enable flow logs for the VPC.
noun.example_zh: 为VPC启用流日志。

noun.example: Fluent Bit forwards logs to various cloud services.
noun.example_zh: Fluent Bit 将日志转发到各种云服务。
noun.gloss: an open-source data collector and processor for logs and metrics
noun.meaning: Fluent Bit 日志和指标处理器

noun.example: Write the folder name on the label of the binder.
noun.example_zh: 在活页夹的标签上写上文件夹名称。
noun.gloss: the name assigned to a physical or digital folder for identification
the name of a directory in a file system
noun.example: The folder name must not contain spaces.
noun.example_zh: 文件夹名称不能包含空格。

noun.gloss: the location of a folder in a file system
noun.example: Enter the folder path where you want to save the file.
noun.example_zh: 输入要保存文件的文件夹路径。

noun.gloss: the way folders are organized in a hierarchy
noun.example: Check the folder structure to find the file.
noun.example_zh: 检查文件夹结构以找到文件。

noun.gloss: the hierarchical organization of folders in a system
noun.example: The folder structure must follow the project guidelines.
noun.example_zh: 文件夹结构必须遵循项目指南。

verb.example: Please follow the guideline for social distancing.
verb.example_zh: 请遵循社交距离的指南。
verb.gloss: adhere to instructions or recommendations

noun.gloss: a list of items or users to follow
noun.example: Add the resource to your follow list for updates.
noun.example_zh: 将资源添加到关注列表以获取更新。

verb.gloss: to act in accordance with a set of rules or guidelines
verb.example: All employees must follow the company's vacation policy.
verb.example_zh: 所有员工都必须遵守公司的休假政策。

verb.example: Ensure that all users follow the least privilege policy.
verb.example_zh: 确保所有用户都遵循最小权限策略。
verb.gloss: to comply with an access policy or security policy

noun.gloss: the dimensions of characters in a typeface
noun.example: Increase the font size for better readability.
noun.example_zh: 增大字体大小以提高可读性。

noun.gloss: the size of text displayed on a screen or document
noun.example: Set the font size to 12px in CSS.
noun.example_zh: 在CSS中将字体大小设置为12像素。

noun.gloss: An algorithm that predicts future values based on historical data.
noun.example: The forecast algorithm can predict demand with high accuracy.
noun.example_zh: 预测算法可以高精度预测需求。

noun.gloss: a field in a database table that links to the primary key of another table
noun.example: Add a foreign key to enforce referential integrity.
noun.example_zh: 添加外键以强制引用完整性。

noun.gloss: a rule that ensures referential integrity between tables by linking a column to the primary key of another table
noun.example: A foreign key constraint prevents orphaned records.
noun.example_zh: 外键约束可防止孤立记录。

noun.example: The forest algorithm improved accuracy compared to a single decision tree.
noun.example_zh: 森林算法比单个决策树提高了准确度。
noun.gloss: a machine learning ensemble method that combines multiple decision trees

noun.example: The system logs each forward request for auditing purposes.
noun.example_zh: 系统记录每个转发的请求用于审计。
noun.gloss: a request that is forwarded or to be forwarded

verb.example: The load balancer forwards requests to the backend servers.
verb.example_zh: 负载均衡器将请求转发到后端服务器。
verb.gloss: to send a request to another destination

noun.gloss: a property of cryptographic systems ensuring that past session keys remain secure even if the long-term key is compromised
noun.example: Enabling forward secrecy in TLS protects past communications from future key leakage.
noun.example_zh: 在 TLS 中启用前向保密可保护过去的通信免受未来密钥泄露的影响。

noun.example: Use a forward slash to separate the day and month, e.g., 01/01/2024.
noun.example_zh: 用正斜杠分隔日和月，例如01/01/2024。
noun.gloss: the symbol (/) used in writing to separate alternatives or parts of a date

noun.example: The file path uses a forward slash as a separator, e.g., /home/user/file.txt.
noun.example_zh: 文件路径使用正斜杠作为分隔符，例如 /home/user/file.txt。
noun.gloss: the symbol (/) used in computing to separate directory names in file paths and as a delimiter in URLs
the process of grabbing a single frame from a video stream
noun.example: Enable frame capture to extract images from the video.
noun.example_zh: 启用帧捕获以从视频中提取图像。

noun.gloss: the input data representing a single frame in video or image processing
noun.example: The model processes each frame input to detect objects.
noun.example_zh: 模型处理每一帧输入以检测物体。

noun.example: Each frame object stores the pixel data.
noun.example_zh: 每个帧对象存储像素数据。
noun.gloss: an object representing a video frame

noun.example: Each function call creates a new frame object on the call stack.
noun.example_zh: 每次函数调用都会在调用栈上创建一个新的帧对象。
noun.gloss: an object representing a stack frame during program execution
the frequency of images in a video
noun.example: This video has a frame rate of 60 fps.
noun.example_zh: 这个视频的帧率是60帧每秒。

noun.gloss: frames per second in digital video processing
noun.example: The game requires a stable frame rate for smooth play.
noun.example_zh: 游戏需要稳定的帧率才能流畅玩。

noun.gloss: the process of identifying fraudulent activities
noun.example: The bank uses fraud detection systems.
noun.example_zh: 银行使用欺诈检测系统。

noun.example: Many cloud providers offer fraud detection services.
noun.example_zh: 许多云服务提供商提供欺诈检测服务。
noun.gloss: a technology service that identifies fraud

noun.example: I have 20 GB of free space on my device.
noun.example_zh: 我的设备上有20GB的空闲空间。
noun.gloss: unused storage capacity on a device
available storage in a cloud volume or instance
noun.example: The instance requires at least 10 GB of free space.
noun.example_zh: 实例至少需要10GB空闲空间。

noun.example: The free tier allows you to evaluate the product before upgrading.
noun.example_zh: 免费套餐让你在升级前可以评估产品。
noun.gloss: A pricing tier that provides services at no cost, typically with usage limits.
a period during which a product or service is offered at no cost
noun.example: You can start a 30-day free trial.
noun.example_zh: 您可以开始30天的免费试用。

noun.gloss: use without charge
noun.example: The park offers free usage of sports facilities.
noun.example_zh: 公园提供免费使用体育设施。

noun.gloss: the amount of free resources in a service tier
noun.example: AWS Free Usage Tier allows limited resources monthly.
noun.example_zh: AWS 免费使用套餐允许每月使用有限资源。

noun.gloss: a user interface field that accepts any text input without constraints
noun.example: Enter your comments in the free-form field.
noun.example_zh: 在自由格式字段中输入您的评论。

noun.example: Enter a friendly name for your virtual machine.
noun.example_zh: 为您的虚拟机输入一个友好名称。
noun.gloss: a human-readable label for a resource
the part that faces forward or is user-facing
noun.example: The front end of the car was damaged.
noun.example_zh: 汽车的前端损坏了。

noun.gloss: the client-side part of a web application
noun.example: The front end communicates with the backend via API.
noun.example_zh: 前端通过 API 与后端通信。

noun.gloss: unrestricted entry or use
noun.example: Members have full access to the gym facilities.
noun.example_zh: 会员可以完全使用健身设施。

noun.gloss: unrestricted access to resources
noun.example: The admin account has full access to all services.
noun.example_zh: 管理员账户对所有服务具有完全访问权限。

noun.gloss: the complete benefit or use of something
noun.example: She took full advantage of the opportunity.
noun.example_zh: 她充分利用了这个机会。

noun.gloss: a complete copy of all selected data at a specific point in time
noun.example: Schedule a full backup of your database every Sunday.
noun.example_zh: 每周日计划一次数据库的完整备份。

noun.gloss: complete authority over something
noun.example: He has full control over his finances.
noun.example_zh: 他对自己的财务有完全控制。

noun.example: You can give the user full control of the storage bucket.
noun.example_zh: 您可以赋予用户对该存储桶的完全控制权限。
noun.gloss: all permissions granted
detailed and comprehensive directions or guidelines
noun.example: Read the full instruction before assembling the furniture.
noun.example_zh: 在组装家具之前阅读完整说明。

noun.gloss: a set of detailed steps or commands, often for an operation or configuration
noun.example: Follow the full instruction to configure the network interface.
noun.example_zh: 按照完整指令配置网络接口。

noun.gloss: A complete enumeration of items
noun.example: Please provide a full list of participants.
noun.example_zh: 请提供参与者的完整列表。

noun.example: The ship sailed with a full load of cargo.
noun.example_zh: 这艘船满载货物启航。
noun.gloss: the condition of carrying the maximum possible weight or load
an initial complete data transfer in database migration
noun.example: The full load may take several hours.
noun.example_zh: 全量加载可能需要几个小时。

noun.gloss: the complete route to a file or location
noun.example: Give me the full path of the document.
noun.example_zh: 给我文档的完整路径。

noun.example: Enter the full path for the resource in the file system.
noun.example_zh: 输入文件系统中资源的完整路径。
noun.gloss: the absolute route from the root directory to a file or directory
complete authorization to do something
noun.example: You have full permission to edit the document.
noun.example_zh: 您有编辑文档的完全许可。

noun.example: The user needs full permission to the cloud storage bucket.
noun.example_zh: 用户需要对云存储桶的完全权限。
noun.gloss: all access rights to a resource

noun.example: Switch to full screen for a better view.
noun.example_zh: 切换到全屏以获得更好视野。
noun.gloss: display occupying the entire screen

adjective.example: Full screen mode hides the menu bar.
adjective.example_zh: 全屏模式隐藏了菜单栏。
adjective.gloss: relating to a mode where content fills the entire screen

adjective.example: The full screen API provides a way to request full screen display.
adjective.example_zh: 全屏 API 提供了一种请求全屏显示的方式。
adjective.gloss: relating to a mode where content fills the entire screen, often used in UI/API contexts
