noun.example_zh: Web 分发配置决定了如何将内容交付给用户。
noun.gloss: the method or configuration for distributing web content to end users
an online form used to collect data from users
noun.example: Please complete the web form to register for the event.
noun.example_zh: 请填写网页表单以注册活动。

noun.gloss: an HTML form element used in web development
noun.example: Validate the web form input before submitting to the server.
noun.example_zh: 在提交到服务器之前验证网页表单输入。

noun.example: The user's web identity from a social media provider was used for authentication.
noun.example_zh: 用户来自社交媒体提供商的 Web 身份用于身份验证。
noun.gloss: a digital identity associated with a user on the web, especially used for federated login
a system that enables users to authenticate using web identity providers
noun.example: Web identity federation allows sign-in with Facebook or Google.
noun.example_zh: Web身份联合允许使用Facebook或Google登录。

noun.gloss: A service that authenticates users via a web-based identity, such as Google or Facebook, for federated access.
noun.example: You can use Amazon Cognito as a web identity provider.
noun.example_zh: 您可以使用Amazon Cognito作为Web身份提供商。

noun.gloss: a graphical interface accessed through a web browser
noun.example: The device has a simple web interface for settings.
noun.example_zh: 该设备有一个简单的网页界面用于设置。

noun.example: Configure the device using the web interface.
noun.example_zh: 使用 Web 接口配置设备。
noun.gloss: a browser-based interface for interacting with a service or application
A website that serves as a gateway to various information and services
noun.example: I log into the company web portal to check my email.
noun.example_zh: 我登录公司门户网站查看邮件。

noun.gloss: A centrally managed web interface that aggregates content from multiple sources
noun.example: The management web portal allows you to configure services.
noun.example_zh: 管理 Web 门户允许您配置服务。

noun.gloss: a server that acts as an intermediary for requests from clients seeking resources from other servers
noun.example: Set up a web proxy to filter internet traffic.
noun.example_zh: 设置Web代理以过滤互联网流量。

noun.gloss: a request sent from a browser to a server
noun.example: The web request timed out due to poor connectivity.
noun.example_zh: 由于连接不良，网络请求超时。

noun.gloss: an HTTP request sent to a web server
noun.example: The load balancer distributes web requests across multiple targets.
noun.example_zh: 负载均衡器将 Web 请求分配到多个目标。

noun.example: The web request component can be inspected by a firewall.
noun.example_zh: Web请求组件可以被防火墙检查。
noun.gloss: a part of a web request, such as headers, URI, or body, used for inspection

noun.example: My blog is hosted on a small web server.
noun.example_zh: 我的博客托管在一台小型网页服务器上。
noun.gloss: a computer that hosts websites and delivers web pages to users
software or hardware that serves HTML content over the internet using HTTP
noun.example: Nginx is a popular web server for high-traffic sites.
noun.example_zh: Nginx 是一种用于高流量站点的流行 Web 服务器。

noun.gloss: A location connected to the Internet that maintains one or more pages.
noun.example: I created a web site for my business.
noun.example_zh: 我为我的生意创建了一个网站。

noun.example: Deploy the web site on a cloud server.
noun.example_zh: 在云服务器上部署网站。
noun.gloss: A collection of related web pages under a domain.
a token used in web authentication, such as JSON Web Token (JWT)
noun.example: The server validates the web token on each request.
noun.example_zh: 服务器在每个请求上验证Web令牌。

noun.gloss: the amount of data sent and received by visitors to a website
noun.example: Our marketing campaign boosted web traffic.
noun.example_zh: 我们的营销活动增加了网络流量。

noun.gloss: HTTP/HTTPS traffic to and from a web server
noun.example: The load balancer distributes web traffic evenly.
noun.example_zh: 负载均衡器均匀分配Web流量。

noun.example: The web UI is intuitive and responsive.
noun.example_zh: 这个网页用户界面直观且响应迅速。
noun.gloss: graphical interface of a website

noun.example: The API is managed through a web UI console.
noun.example_zh: 通过 Web 用户界面控制台管理 API。
noun.gloss: front-end interface of a web application

noun.example: Ensure the website endpoint is configured correctly for your hosting service.
noun.example_zh: 确保为你的托管服务正确配置网站端点。
noun.gloss: the internet-accessible address used to access a website hosted on a service or server
a service or server that stores and serves website files
noun.example: Choose a reliable website host for your online store.
noun.example_zh: 为你的在线商店选择一个可靠的网站托管服务。

noun.example: The chat application uses a WebSocket API for instant messaging.
noun.example_zh: 聊天应用使用WebSocket API进行即时消息传递。
noun.gloss: An application programming interface that uses the WebSocket protocol for real-time, two-way communication.

noun.example: The chat application uses a WebSocket connection for real-time messaging.
noun.example_zh: 聊天应用程序使用 WebSocket 连接进行实时消息传递。
noun.gloss: a persistent, bidirectional communication channel established using the WebSocket protocol
Maintenance performed weekly
noun.example: The building undergoes weekly maintenance on Sundays.
noun.example_zh: 大楼每周日进行维护。

noun.gloss: Scheduled system maintenance occurring every week
noun.example: The server downtime is scheduled for weekly maintenance.
noun.example_zh: 服务器停机时间安排在每周维护。

noun.gloss: a scheduled period each week for maintenance
noun.example: The weekly maintenance window is Sunday morning.
noun.example_zh: 每周维护窗口是周日上午。

noun.gloss: a recurring time period for system maintenance
noun.example: Database patching occurs during the weekly maintenance window.
noun.example_zh: 数据库补丁在每周维护窗口期间进行。

noun.gloss: a logged measurement of a person's body weight
noun.example: She keeps a daily weight record in a journal.
noun.example_zh: 她每天在日记中记录体重。

noun.example: The model stores a weight record for each parameter.
noun.example_zh: 模型为每个参数存储一条权重记录。
noun.gloss: a data entry representing the weight of a feature in a machine learning model
a feature in contact centers that plays an introductory message to an agent before connecting to a customer
noun.example: Configure a whisper flow to play a message to the agent.
noun.example_zh: 配置耳语流以向座席播放消息。

noun.gloss: the empty area between things, or in text
noun.example: Please leave some white space on the page for margins.
noun.example_zh: 请在页面上留出一些空白作为边距。

noun.gloss: characters like space, tab, newline
noun.example: Remove trailing white space from the code.
noun.example_zh: 删除代码尾部的空白字符。

noun.gloss: a number without fractions; an integer
noun.example: The answer must be a whole number.
noun.example_zh: 答案必须是整数。

noun.gloss: an integer data type in computing
noun.example: The field accepts only whole numbers.
noun.example_zh: 该字段仅接受整数。

noun.gloss: a wireless local area network
noun.example: Connect to a Wi-Fi network at home.
noun.example_zh: 在家连接Wi-Fi网络。

noun.gloss: a wireless network infrastructure
noun.example: The device requires a stable Wi-Fi network connection.
noun.example_zh: 设备需要稳定的Wi-Fi网络连接。

noun.example: The policy uses a wide condition to cover multiple services.
noun.example_zh: 该策略使用宽泛条件来涵盖多种服务。
noun.gloss: a condition that applies to many situations or resources

noun.example: In wide-column databases, a wide key (composite key) can help organize data by including multiple attributes, enabling efficient range queries and sorting.
noun.example_zh: 在宽列数据库中，宽键（复合键）通过包含多个属性来组织数据，从而实现高效的区间查询和排序。
noun.gloss: A database key that is composed of multiple parts or attributes, often used in wide-column stores for efficient data retrieval.
a large variety or scope
noun.example: We offer a wide range of products.
noun.example_zh: 我们提供广泛的产品。

noun.gloss: a large number of different types
noun.example: The store sells a wide variety of accessories.
noun.example_zh: 这家店销售多种多样的配饰。

noun.example: He is a wild card in the competition.
noun.example_zh: 他是比赛中的一匹黑马。
noun.gloss: A person or thing that is unpredictable or not expected to succeed.

noun.example: Use a wild card to match multiple files.
noun.example_zh: 使用通配符匹配多个文件。
noun.gloss: A character that can substitute for any other character(s) in a string.
a special character that can represent one or more characters in a search pattern
noun.example: The asterisk is a common wildcard character.
noun.example_zh: 星号是一种常见的通配符。

noun.gloss: a group of wind turbines used to generate electricity
noun.example: The wind farm provides clean energy.
noun.example_zh: 风力发电场提供清洁能源。

noun.gloss: a group of wind turbines for electricity generation, often powering data centers
noun.example: The data center is powered by a nearby wind farm.
noun.example_zh: 数据中心由附近的风电场供电。

noun.gloss: a computer program that runs in a graphical window
noun.example: He opened a window application to edit the document.
noun.example_zh: 他打开了一个窗口应用程序来编辑文档。

noun.example: The window application runs on any operating system with a graphical interface.
noun.example_zh: 该窗口应用程序可在任何具有图形界面的操作系统上运行。
noun.gloss: a desktop application that runs in a windowed environment

noun.example: Install the Windows client to connect to the remote desktop.
noun.example_zh: 安装Windows客户端以连接到远程桌面。
noun.gloss: a client application running on the Windows operating system

noun.example: You can use the Windows command to check disk usage.
noun.example_zh: 您可以使用 Windows 命令来检查磁盘使用情况。
noun.gloss: a command executed in the Microsoft Windows command-line environment
an event that occurs in a graphical user interface window
noun.example: The function responds to a window event.
noun.example_zh: 该函数响应窗口事件。

noun.example: Back up data to the Windows file server.
noun.example_zh: 将数据备份到 Windows 文件服务器。
noun.gloss: a file server running on Windows operating system
a function that performs a calculation across a set of rows that are related to the current row
noun.example: Use a window function to compute a moving average.
noun.example_zh: 使用窗口函数计算移动平均值。

noun.example: The Windows node is part of the compute cluster.
noun.example_zh: Windows节点是计算集群的一部分。
noun.gloss: a node running Windows in a cluster or service
the Microsoft operating system family
noun.example: Check if your version of Windows operating system is supported.
noun.example_zh: 检查您的 Windows 操作系统版本是否受支持。

noun.gloss: a query using window functions
noun.example: The window query returns running totals.
noun.example_zh: 窗口查询返回运行总计。

noun.gloss: a database in Windows operating systems that stores configuration settings
noun.example: Be careful when modifying the Windows registry.
noun.example_zh: 修改 Windows 注册表时要小心。

noun.gloss: a virtual machine running Windows Server
noun.example: The Windows Server instance handles authentication.
noun.example_zh: Windows 服务器实例处理身份验证。

noun.gloss: the ordering of application windows in a graphical user interface
noun.example: The window stack determines which window appears on top.
noun.example_zh: 窗口堆栈决定了哪个窗口显示在最上层。

noun.gloss: Software patches for Microsoft Windows
noun.example: My computer restarted after a Windows update.
noun.example_zh: 我的电脑在 Windows 更新后重启了。

noun.gloss: The service that delivers OS and security updates to Windows machines
noun.example: Manage Windows Update across your EC2 instances with AWS Systems Manager.
noun.example_zh: 使用 AWS Systems Manager 管理您的 EC2 实例上的 Windows 更新。

noun.example: Use the wireless API to register a device.
noun.example_zh: 使用无线 API 注册设备。
noun.gloss: an API that enables wireless communication or management of wireless devices
electronic equipment that communicates without cables, like a smartphone
noun.example: I use a wireless device for calls.
noun.example_zh: 我用无线设备打电话。

noun.gloss: a hardware endpoint that connects to a network via wireless protocols
noun.example: The wireless device must be provisioned on the network.
noun.example_zh: 无线设备需在网络中配置。

noun.example: I need to reboot the wireless gateway because the internet is down.
noun.example_zh: 我需要重启无线网关，因为互联网断了。
noun.gloss: a device that connects home devices to the internet via a broadband connection, often combining a router, switch, and access point
a device connecting wireless devices to a network
noun.example: The wireless gateway connects sensors to the cloud.
noun.example_zh: 无线网关将传感器连接到云。

noun.gloss: deployment through a step-by-step wizard
noun.example: Complete the wizard deployment to launch the stack.
noun.example_zh: 完成向导部署以启动堆栈。

noun.gloss: a website powered by the WordPress content management system
noun.example: The company launched a new WordPress website.
noun.example_zh: 公司推出了一个新的 WordPress 网站。

noun.gloss: a directory where files are stored during a job or process
noun.example: Change to the work directory before running the script.
noun.example_zh: 运行脚本前切换到工作目录。

noun.gloss: a task or to-do item in a list of things to accomplish
noun.example: Add the new feature as a work item on the board.
noun.example_zh: 将新功能作为工作项添加到看板上。

noun.gloss: a unit of work in a project management or development tool
noun.example: Assign the work item to a developer in Jira.
noun.example_zh: 在 Jira 中将工作项分配给开发人员。

noun.gloss: a sample of one's work, often used in job applications
noun.example: Please attach a work sample to your application.
noun.example_zh: 请在申请中附上工作样本。

noun.gloss: a representative piece of work, same as daily usage
noun.example: The work sample showed their coding skills.
noun.example_zh: 工作样本展示了他们的编程技能。

noun.gloss: a group of people working together
noun.example: The work team completed the project ahead of schedule.
noun.example_zh: 工作团队提前完成了项目。

noun.example: Assign tasks to the work team through the platform.
noun.example_zh: 通过平台将任务分配给工作团队。
noun.gloss: a collaboration team in productivity tools

noun.example: The foreman gave the worker an instruction.
noun.example_zh: 工头向工人发出了指令。
noun.gloss: a command given to a worker

noun.example: The coordinator dispatches a worker instruction to the node.
noun.example_zh: 协调器向节点分派一个工作者指令。
noun.gloss: an instruction for a processing worker in a distributed system
a compute instance that runs containerized applications in a cluster
noun.example: The Kubernetes worker node runs the pods.
noun.example_zh: Kubernetes 工作节点运行 Pod。

noun.gloss: a step in a sequence of tasks
noun.example: Each workflow step must be completed in order.
noun.example_zh: 工作流程中的每一步都必须按顺序完成。

noun.example: The workflow step timed out after five minutes.
noun.example_zh: 工作流步骤在五分钟后超时。
noun.gloss: a step in an orchestrated workflow process
the structure and design of cloud workloads
noun.example: Assess the workload architecture for best practices.
noun.example_zh: 评估工作负载架构以符合最佳实践。

noun.gloss: a distinct part of a cloud workload, such as a compute or database tier
noun.example: Each workload component should be independently scalable.
noun.example_zh: 每个工作负载组件应该可以独立扩展。

noun.gloss: the administration and optimization of cloud workloads
noun.example: Implement workload management to balance resources.
noun.example_zh: 实施工作负载管理以平衡资源。

noun.gloss: how well a system handles a set of tasks
noun.example: Monitor the workload performance to ensure smooth operation.
noun.example_zh: 监控工作负载性能以确保平稳运行。

noun.gloss: the needs and specifications of a computational workload
noun.example: Assess your workload requirements before migrating.
noun.example_zh: 迁移前评估您的工作负载要求。

noun.gloss: a client application used to access a virtual desktop or workspace
noun.example: You need to install the workspace client to connect to your cloud desktop.
noun.example_zh: 您需要安装工作区客户端以连接到云桌面。

noun.example: Set the workspace directory to your project folder.
noun.example_zh: 将工作区目录设置到您的项目文件夹。
noun.gloss: a directory that contains workspace files for a development environment or application

noun.example: The administrator created a new workspace directory for user desktops.
noun.example_zh: 管理员为用户桌面创建了一个新的工作区目录。
noun.gloss: a directory that organizes virtual desktop instances or session data
permission to modify or add data
noun.example: I need write access to the shared folder.
noun.example_zh: 我需要共享文件夹的写入权限。

noun.gloss: permission to write or modify data in a system
noun.example: The user does not have write access to the database.
noun.example_zh: 用户没有数据库的写入权限。

noun.example: Excessive write activity can degrade SSD performance.
noun.example_zh: 过多的写入活动会降低固态盘的性能。
noun.gloss: operations that write data to storage
the amount of write throughput available, often in DynamoDB or storage systems
noun.example: If you exceed the table's write capacity, requests get throttled.
noun.example_zh: 如果超出表的写入容量，请求会被限制。

noun.example: The database supports multiple concurrent write operations.
noun.example_zh: 数据库支持多个并发写操作。
noun.gloss: an operation that writes or modifies data in a database, file, etc.
authorization to modify or add content
noun.example: You need write permission to edit this document.
noun.example_zh: 您需要写入权限才能编辑此文档。

noun.gloss: a filesystem or database permission that allows modification
noun.example: The application requires write permission to the log directory.
noun.example_zh: 应用程序需要对日志目录的写入权限。

noun.gloss: an operation in a database or storage system that writes data to disk
noun.example: The application sends a write request to the database to save the user's information.
noun.example_zh: 应用程序向数据库发送写请求以保存用户信息。

noun.gloss: the rate at which data can be written
noun.example: Increase write throughput to handle peak load.
noun.example_zh: 增加写入吞吐量以处理峰值负载。

noun.gloss: a database instance that handles write operations, as opposed to read replicas
noun.example: The writer instance synchronizes with read replicas.
noun.example_zh: 写入实例与只读副本同步。

noun.example: The service uses X.509 certificates for authentication.
noun.example_zh: 该服务使用X.509证书进行身份验证。
noun.gloss: a digital certificate format used for secure communications

noun.example: Use the XGBoost algorithm for accurate predictions.
noun.example_zh: 使用 XGBoost 算法进行准确预测。
noun.gloss: an optimized gradient boosting machine learning algorithm

noun.example: Train an XGBoost model on the dataset.
noun.example_zh: 在数据集上训练一个 XGBoost 模型。
noun.gloss: a machine learning model using the XGBoost algorithm

noun.example: The configuration is stored in an XML file.
noun.example_zh: 配置存储在 XML 文件中。
noun.gloss: a file that contains data formatted in Extensible Markup Language

noun.example: The configuration is defined in a YAML file.
noun.example_zh: 配置在YAML文件中定义。
noun.gloss: a file containing data serialized in YAML format
Data serialization format using indentation, often for configuration files
noun.example: Store the configuration in YAML format.
noun.example_zh: 以YAML格式存储配置。

noun.gloss: a space-filling curve that maps multidimensional data to one dimension while preserving locality
noun.example: The Z-order curve improves spatial query performance.
noun.example_zh: Z-order曲线提高了空间查询性能。

noun.gloss: a compressed file container using ZIP format
noun.example: I sent you the documents as a zip archive.
noun.example_zh: 我把文件以 ZIP 压缩包形式发给你了。

noun.gloss: an archive file compressed with the ZIP algorithm
noun.example: The deployment package is a zip archive containing the code.
noun.example_zh: 部署包是一个包含代码的 ZIP 存档。

noun.gloss: a postal code used in the United States
noun.example: Enter your zip code to find nearby stores.
noun.example_zh: 输入邮政编码以查找附近的商店。

noun.gloss: a required field in address validation for e-commerce or location services
noun.example: Validate the zip code format before saving the address.
noun.example_zh: 保存地址之前验证邮政编码格式。

noun.example: I sent the photos as a zip file.
noun.example_zh: 我把照片作为压缩文件发送了。
noun.gloss: a file compressed with the ZIP format
the root domain of a DNS zone, e.g., example.com (without www)
noun.example: Configure a zone apex record to point to the load balancer.
noun.example_zh: 配置区域顶点记录以指向负载均衡器。

noun.gloss: a text file describing a DNS zone
noun.example: The zone file contains all the DNS records.
noun.example_zh: 区域文件包含所有DNS记录。

noun.example: Data in zone storage is replicated within the same availability zone.
noun.example_zh: 可用区存储中的数据会在同一可用区内进行复制。
noun.gloss: Storage resources that are associated with a specific availability zone within a cloud region
